summary: Documentation audit and Confluence migration: moved the S004 passport + E0-E11 experiments log (docs/STRATEGY_S004.md, docs/EXPERIMENTS.md) and the gap-fade research handoff (docs/HANDOFF_GAP_FADE_RESEARCH.md, previously untracked) to Confluence pages under Strategies (ids 10944530, 11042817), leaving English pointer stubs in the repo. Fixed stale claims: README live preset WORKING_S007 -> WORKING_S007_LIQFLOOR and outdated "S007 backtests not mirrored" note, expanded runner/docs lists; bot/S007_README.md preset BASELINE_S007 -> WORKING_S007_LIQFLOOR; deployment/schedule.yml and scripts/fetch_deribit_snapshot.py comments "S012 candidate" -> S013 (Deribit strangle was renumbered when S012 went to cross-sectional momentum). Confluence Strategies page updated to v7 (S004 link + pre-registry candidates section). Known drift left for consent: .claude/skills/strategy-lifecycle/SKILL.md line 56 still names the moved docs as live.

ALGODEV-62 phase A: S004-intraday as a real preset instead of research post-processing. New strategies/s004_config.py is S004's config home (frozen S004_BASE champion = the parameters the passport fixes, plus CORE_PAIRS/PIP_RAW/SPREAD_PIPS/ASIA_HOURS moved out of backtest/s004_metalabel_data.py so they have a single source of truth), and S004_INTRADAY = S004_BASE.with_() carrying the three prop rules fixed before the run: close everything at 22:45 server, size on (stop + spread), at most 2 entries per server day across the whole 7-pair portfolio. Rules 1-2 are new default-off flags on fvg_mtf.run_backtest (intraday_cutoff, cost_inclusive_sizing); rule 3 is portfolio-level and lives in the new backtest/run_s004_intraday.py, which is also the regression harness. Engine flags are default-off, so the S016 branch and the frozen S004 champion are untouched: 'run_s004_intraday regression' reproduces reports/s004_metalabel_dataset.csv trade for trade (5018 trades, max|delta| 4.44e-16). Running the rules INSIDE the engine rather than over a finished trade list materially changes the result, because a position cut at 22:45 frees S004's one-position-per-pair lock the same evening and lets later entries exist at all: on the untouched 2022-03+ window 1790 trades at +0.164 R/trade, 5/5 years positive, worst day -2.00R, vs the research script's 1291 trades at +0.120. All three phase-A acceptance gates pass (OOS R/trade >= +0.08, every OOS year positive, worst day >= -2R); the worst day is capped at exactly -2R by construction, since cost-inclusive sizing makes a full stop exactly -1R and the daily cap allows two. Gate 0 (no-look-ahead) re-run after the engine change: EURUSD/GBPJPY all 10 features max|delta|=0. Full suite 668 passed.

ALGODEV-62 follow-up: the prop emulator now scales the ENGINE-produced S004-intraday trade list (reports/s004_intraday_portfolio_trades.csv from backtest/run_s004_intraday.py) instead of the `fx` step's post-processed one, and the script itself is committed -- it was untracked, so the economics the ticket quotes were reproducible from nobody's machine but the author's /tmp. The engine path both frees S004's one-position-per-pair lock the same evening and drops the shadow non-Asia trades post-processing left in, so the S004 leg is 1790 trades at +0.164 R/trade on 2022-03+ instead of 1291 at +0.120. Re-measured, FundingPips-like 8/5, $10k, $100/attempt, 3y median: S021 2% alone +5401 (all data) / +5558 (2022-03+); S004i 1%x2 alone +17504 / +13390; S021 2% + S004i 0.5%x2 +14920 / +13063; S021 2% + S004i 1%x2 +23859 / +19959, whose worst historical 3y replay is +17143 and whose worst day is -4.03% against the firm's -5% limit. Daily-R correlation between the two legs stays -0.03. `fx` is kept as the archived research path (documented as the conservative lower bound), and prop() now fails loudly if the engine trade list is missing.

ALGODEV-62 phase B: measured the S004 session clock from the M15 data instead of assuming it (run_s004_clock_probe.py -- the European morning holds its clock hour across both the EU and the US DST transitions, 26 transitions x 3 pairs), pinned it as s004_config.SESSION_TZ = Europe/Bucharest = Clock.mqh TZ_EET_EU_DST, and taught gen_params.py to render Strategies/S004_FVG/Params.mqh from S004_INTRADAY so the EA restates no rule by hand. Export is refused if any of the three prop rules is off.

ALGODEV-62 phase C: ported strategies/fvg_mtf.py::run_backtest to MQL5 (Strategies/S004_FVG/Engine.mqh, pure, no orders) and proved it with a self-test that replays Python-made fixtures: 99659 M15 bars on EURUSD and GBPJPY, 1102 trades reproduced one for one (12132 checks, 0 failures). The expectation deliberately keeps the shadow trades outside the Asia window, because they consume their zone and hold the one-position-per-symbol lock. Added mt5/tools/run_selftest.sh, which runs a self-test script headlessly in a throwaway portable terminal (no profiles, experts off) so the terminal that is trading is never touched -- MT5 silently drops a second instance on the same folder.

ALGODEV-62: kept the whole MT5 side under mt5/, like S021. Moved the session-clock probe out of backtest/ into mt5/tools/s004_clock_probe.py (it exists for the EA, next to clock.py and the other mt5 tools) and updated every reference, including the generated Params.mqh comment. Documented the S004 headers, self-test and tools in mt5/README.md. Hardened run_selftest.sh: it matched the sandbox by its unix path, but the wine process reports the windows one, so a leftover terminal survived and MT5 then dropped the new instance and the run timed out.

ALGODEV-62 (question from the maintainer): is one 2% entry a day worse than two at 1%? Added run_s004_daily_cap.py, which re-caps the engine trade list at 1/2/3 entries per day with the risk scaled so every variant plans the same -2% worst day. Answer: the first signal of the day is the best one -- cap 1 beats cap 2 on R/trade in every year since 2019, out of sample (+0.259 vs +0.164) and under a 1.15x stop stress, and roughly doubles the emulator median. The price is diversification: it busts the challenge about twice as often (13.7 vs 6.9 attempts per 3 years). Not promoted -- the base stays frozen pending a proper walk-forward.

ALGODEV-62: made the two S004-intraday sizing dials tunable instead of hardcoded. risk_pct is now a field of S004Config, both it and max_trades_per_day are exported as EA input defaults (S004_DEFAULT_*), and their product is checked against the new DAILY_RISK_BUDGET_PCT=2% -- S004 share of the firm -5% daily limit -- so an impossible pair cannot be exported. Added run_s004_risk_grid.py, which measures the cap x risk grid by busts per 3 years: the budget edge is a cliff (cap 2 goes 3.0 -> 7.1 -> 32.8 busts at 0.50/1.00/1.50%). The default stays 2 x 1.00% per the maintainer. Engine regression and the MQL5 self-test still pass unchanged.

Added the S004 live MQL5 layer (Runtime.mqh + EA shell) for ALGODEV-62 phase C. It parks one resting limit per symbol on the zone Engine.mqh would take next, keeps out-of-session and over-cap trades virtual so they still consume their zone, and replays warmup bars on restart instead of persisting state. TradeOps gained Modify() to retarget SL/TP after a gap fill. All .mq5 compile clean; self-test 12132/0.
